about: The base schemas of FoodBlock 1.6: what the protocol reads of its own kinds, as data. Each entry is the state of a thing of kind schema (things.md, Schemas). make.cjs (sdk/javascript/test/make-schemas.cjs) signs them in this order with the publisher key and writes published.json, so each has a stable id. A schema's `fields` are names with a free hint of the value; nothing checks the hint. A new schema goes at the end of the list: the ids before it never change.

publisher.note: The seed is public on purpose: anyone can rebuild every id. The publisher is a convention for finding these schemas, not an authority. A reader trusts a schema only by the rules of authority.md (the grantor's own, or one the grantor confirmed).

fields.name: text
fields.words: the words printed on it, as first read
fields.pack: an amount: what one instance holds

fields.target: the type, or type.kind, it is for
fields.roles: the ref keys it declares beyond the shared ones

fields.shares: [{ from, share }]: how much of each input the output carries, a decimal string

fields.per_stranger: most blocks one day may bring from anyone else (an integer)
fields.order_channel: the acts, as type.kind, an agent may send first (a list)

fields.limit: money: the most the agent may spend
fields.per: a duration: the period the limit covers

grounds.event: the principal set the fence on the grant named in refs.for

fields.to: for move: the custodian or node (an id)

grounds.event: the person said it, or a recorder heard it and kept the raw message in derives_from

fields.accuracy: an amount, in the unit of the reading
fields.coverage: a decimal from 0 to 1: how much was seen
fields.method: how: sensor, import, or a model's name

grounds.event: the sensor, or a reader of evidence, saw it; refs.from names the sensor

fields.amount: an amount: the hours or the quantity
fields.line: the id of the promise line it is for

fields.scheme: the register: eudi, cnpj, rfc, abn, uscc, national_id, device
fields.value: the number, or a commitment to it

grounds.event: the issuer checked the register or the maker's record
the voter owned the shares named in refs.of when the counter read the ownership fold; each owned instance is one vote

fields.kept: an integer: promises whose stage is done
fields.broken: an integer: promises stopped, declined or expired after a binding accept, or reversed

grounds.event: the promise stages of refs.subject, read by the writer; a reader recomputes them from the promises named in derives_from (folds.md, Kept and broken)
the receiver says it arrived: their accepted answer to the transfer, before the promise's terms.deliver_by
the sensor read past the line for the time terms.condition names (reading_condition, profiles/tasks.md); the schema's confirmers settle a dispute about the reading
the lesson was given: the learner's accepted answer to the teacher's work block; a learner's make names the teacher's recipe in derives_from, with the share in state.shares if one was agreed
the lender advanced the money (a payout record the borrower accepts) and it came back (the repayment, accepted by the lender)

fields.text: what it was for, in words

grounds.event: the payer paid it: the transfer in derives_from; the receiver's accepted answer confirms. A loan's advance is a payout record too
